 KNOW BEFORE YOU GO: Washington Spirit vs Portland Thorns FC – 2026 NWSL Playoffs Quarterfinal
 Washington Spirit   |   November 6, 2026 
 GET TICKETS 
 MATCH HUB 
 MATCHDAY GUIDE 
 We break down everything you need to know ahead of Sunday’s Quarterfinal Match against Portland at Audi Field. 
 📅 SCHEDULE: 
 1:30 PM – Gates open
 2:15 PM – Warm-ups begin
 3:00 PM – Kickoff
 Before Arriving
 🎒 REVIEW THE BAGGAGE POLICY: Bags must be smaller than 14″ by 14″ by 6″. No backpacks, coolers, or luggage are allowed. Review Audi’s Field Guide for information on restricted items (ie no umbrellas) . Fans with medical needs or diaper bags should email Audi Field’s Guest Experience  and use Gate B to expedite entry. 
 🚘 PARKING: Washington Spirit fans can purchase parking near Audi Field in Akridge Lot 147 for the quarterfinal match on November 8 by clicking HERE. 
 Prematch
 MARCH TO THE MATCH: Meet up with Spirit Supporters Groups at 2:15 p.m. ET just inside Gate A before the march around the concourse at 2:30 p.m. ET. Join as you can! 
 🎶  ENTERTAINMENT: Crashed Chords will b e performing at the Spirit Stage inside of Gate A at 1:30 p.m. ET!
 🩷 PREMATCH HONOREES & CEREMONY 
 NATIONAL ANTHEM: Regina Aquino
 COLOR GUARD: MPD Honor Guard
 HONORARY CAPTAIN: Ashley Maursak, CVS Health
 Off the Pitch
 👕 GIVEAWAY: The first 9,500 fans will take home an exclusive “Our Moment” bandana presented by American Beverage Association, CVS Health, and MARS. 
 🎁 GIVEAWAY: The first 2,500 fans will receive a CVS Health gift card to celebrate the start of the 2026 NWSL Playoffs. 
 💫 SPIRITVILLE: 
 Don’t miss our Cherry Blossom balloon as you enter the stadium. Grab a photo with it as we celebrate the start of the playoffs! 
 Face painters 
 Lafayette Federal Credit Union: Visit the table in Spiritville to enter to win a matchday upgrade 
 First eight (8) fans will receive field passes for prematch warmups 
 One (1) fan will be upgraded to a Loge Seat for the match 
 Poster making station 
 Quarterfinal Moment photo opportunities 
 Friendship bracelet making station 
 After the final whistle, enjoy samples from Sol de Janeiro as you make your way out of Audi Field 
 📣 HALFTIME SHOWCASE: Spirit Crew Performance . 
 🍺 HAPPY HOUR: 
 $6.50 beer* at the main bar in Section 106 from gates opening until kickoff (while supplies last) 
 ❇️ ROOFTOP: The Heineken Rooftop is open! 
 Items of the Match
 Stay warm with the “Our City, Our Moment, Our Spirit” scarf! Grab your gear and support the team proudly. 
 🛍️ HOW TO GET YOURS: Purchase during the game at the following merch locations: Spiritville and Club level merch locations. 
 If you placed an online order for in-stadium pickup, please use the designated line at the Spirit Shop location in Spiritville to collect your order, and  please have your order confirmation number ready. 
 👚 KIT CUSTOMIZATION: Drop off your jersey by 3 p.m. ET for same-day customization with any Spirit player’s name and number.
 Grab Your Gear 
 Postmatch
 🔒 ACCESS: For the safety of players and guests, only Premium ticketholders (F1-F12, C1-C9, and S1-S31) are allowed in sections F1-F12 along the east sideline after the match. General ticketholders wanting to get closer to the field after the match can head to sections 135-138. Learn more > 
 Transportation
 🚅 METRO: Audi Field can be accessed from both the Navy Yard-Ballpark and Waterfront stations. The ADA shuttle will run from the west entrance to the Audi Field Club Shop on a continuous 15-30 minute loop, starting an hour before kickoff and ending an hour after the match.Parking is available at the Anacostia station, just one stop away on the Green Line.
 🚗 PARKING: Members, make sure to book your parking ahead of time with your member discount code through SpotHero.
 🚲 BIKING: Two Wheel Valet allows fans to store their bikes during the match. The valet is at the southwest corner of the stadium at the intersection of 2nd and T St. The valet opens when gates open and will remain open at least one hour after the end of a match.
 Accessibility
 Guests with special needs or accessibility questions are encouraged to contact the Audi Field Guest Experience team (guestexperience@dcunited.com) prior to matchday. To learn more about the courtesy shuttle, sensory room, and accessible seating, click here . 
 KULTURECITY SENSORY ROOM: Fans with sensory sensitivities can take a break from the visual and auditory stimulations of matchday in the KultureCity Sensory Room, located on the Heineken Rooftop.  
 SENSORY BAGS: Additionally, sensory bags are available while supplies last at Guest Services for any guest who may feel overwhelmed by the environment. Each bag is equipped with noise-cancelling headphones, fidget tools, and verbal cue cards.
 TEXT FOR HELP: Text (202) 888-2375 for fan assistance if you’re in need while at Audi Field.
